a.text: Construction of St Bartholomews Anglican Church began.

b.text: Tenders were called for the construction of St Bartholomews Church in August 1838.

a.text: The site was leased to the Council of the City of Blacktown.

b.text: A fifty-year lease over most of the property was obtained by Council in 1975.

a.text: The area was settled by Europeans by 1789.

b.text: Watkin Tench made another official journey to the west in 1789.

a.text: A meeting near Prospect Hill was held on 3 May 1805.

b.text: The conference at Prospect on Friday 3 May 1805 led to the end of the conflict for the Aboriginal clans around Parramatta and Prospect.

a.text: The church ceiling was covered with timber.

b.text: The church was reroofed with corrugated iron.
